how1: The setup. A stock's daily close is 18% or more above its close 20 trading days ago, it made a clear new high in those 20 days, higher than anything in the last 60 days, and it has not dipped yet. The dip buy is the price where the hourly RSI (14) would touch 30. Lower buys wait where it would touch 29, 28, 27, 25, 24, 23, 22 and 20.
how2: Sell and stop. The plan sells half when price gets back to the hourly 12 EMA, but only if the trade is in profit. The stop goes to breakeven. Sells rest at hourly 26 EMA. If trade not in profit, sells entirely at hourly 26 EMA. The stop sits 6 normal hourly bars under the buy.
how4: Context on each card. The colored tags show wild or calm, a fresh or stale top, and an earnings report that is close or just happened. Under them: how much the stock is up in the last 20 trading days, its daily volume in dollars, and the next earnings report day (confirmed or a guess). A dip the morning after a report tends to go deeper.
opensub: Setups that already reached the first buy. They stay here until the trade ends.
sub: Stocks up 18% or more in 20 trading days to a new high clearly above anything in the 60 days before it.
